name: m3ter
summary: m3ter ingests usage measurements by API or file upload, prices aggregated usage with tiered, volume and stairstep options, and produces bills with usage line items. It targets mid-size and large B2B SaaS companies and publishes no prices.

facts.text: Usage reaches m3ter by API or file upload, with up to 1,000 measurements per API request.
Ingestion is idempotent within a 35-day window, and ingested measurements are corrected with positive or negative corrective measurements.
Pricing types include Tiered, Volume and Stairstep, and a custom pricing description appears against usage line items on bills.
For usage charges only billing in arrears is supported, and a minimum spend can be billed with usage over the minimum added on top.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: A monthly core platform fee with allowances for ingested usage data and bill calculations, plus add-ons, support packages and implementation services. No amounts are published

hiddenCosts: Enhanced support and implementation services cost extra on top of the core platform fee.
